status: Design freeze before any project-specific new-task model fitting/prediction/risk. Execution runner and its tests must also be frozen before real-data fits; current source implements preflight, grouping and preprocessing, not the complete experiment.
development_basis: Methods fixed after E10--E17 and manuscriptv4. No project-specific ChaosNLI/DICES predictive outcomes inspected. Source validity, annotation counts and group feasibility inspected; published source benchmark tables were accessible. Ren and all earlier16 families remain development data.
scope: Three new human-vote distribution tasks in TWO text application families (NLI and conversation safety), not three independent domains or cross-modality confirmation. SNLI/MNLI are related strata. This does not resolve missing original image-subject IDs.

ChaosSNLI.target: label_count/100 in official [E,N,C] order; verify supplied label_dist agrees
ChaosSNLI.groups: Connected components of shared original SNLI image ID parsed before .jpg# and exact NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized premise. Image-source grouping is not person identity.

ChaosMNLI.groups: Connected components of normalized premise. No document/author-disjoint claim without verified document/author IDs.

DICES990.target: Per-item empirical frequencies of Q_overall across all released rater rows; no category-based/demographic exclusion. Aggregated per-rater safety judgment, not a majority-label one-hot target.
DICES990.groups: Connected components sharing item_id, normalized nonempty context, or normalized context-response pair. Empty contexts never all merged.
DICES990.eligibility: Exclude every entire item_id mapping to multiple normalized context-response pairs, before label/risk-based decisions. One such item found; excluded ID recorded privately. No duplicated item/rater keys found. Actual file has172 raters and eligible-item annotation counts69--76, differing from repository narrative; use pinned-file facts.

partitions.group_assignment: design.folds: randomly permute complete connected groups, greedily assign least-populated fold, lower-fold tie. Every eligible object queried once.
partitions.fit_cap_rule: Whole groups only; in seeded order add group if it fits remaining cap, otherwise skip; no query membership. Minimum128 fitting objects, else mark case unavailable, no alternate split.
partitions.inner_grouping: Restrict original connected groups to complete capped-fit groups; never regroup only from embedding duplicates. Shared inner folds for all learners.

features.identity: Classical shared text representation, not a foundation-language-model/SOTA NLP evaluation. All IDs, old/new labels, annotation counts, raters and demographic/quality metadata excluded from predictor inputs. Geometry acts on latent SVD axes, not original semantic-token importance.
features.isolation: Refit BOTH TFIDF vocabulary/IDF and SVD on each INNER training fold. Fit-only min/max and geometry after that. Outer queries only transform using outer-fit encoder. Never cache one outer-trained SVD for inner model selection. No query clipping.
features.failure: Empty vocabulary, rank<32, invalid finite transforms or fit failure makes candidate/case unavailable; no post-outcome representation substitute.

primary.estimand: Mean per-object Brier(GG50)-Brier(UU50), K=floor(n_fit/2), k5, half-prior alpha0.5, geometric bisection and zeta0.5/beta1 profile settings pinned to parent source. Exact same state-array capacity in each paired case.
primary.hypotheses: Negative in each of TWO application families. Score each corpus by object-pooled five-fold predictions; NLI family is equal mean of SNLI and MNLI corpus risks. DICES family is its primary all-rater corpus. Show each corpus separately. Do not claim generality across all three if a stratum reverses. Zero or positive family effect fails that family directional criterion.
primary.reporting: No repeated folds as independent datasets; no confirmatory p-value from5folds or2families. Any all-family composite is descriptive. Keep all outcomes and ties1e-12.

secondary.fixed_policies: UU/GU/UG/GG at50% with k5/halfprior; GG andUU at25/75/100%; plain mean. Construction/query conditional contrasts and interactions secondary. No query-cost acquisition claim from latent text coordinates; cost40 not part of E18.
secondary.restricted_selection: G andU budgets25/50/75/100 xk3/5/10/20 xprior0/.5 plus mean; AA-kNN k4/5/10/20/40 xprior0/.5 plus mean; Ridge+Euclidean simplex projection lambda1e-4/.01/1/100 xprior0/.5 plus mean; pointwise training-gamma RkNN anchors(k5,1e-3,1e-6),(k20,1e-3,1e-6),(k20,1e-2,1e-5), checkpoints100/500/1000, prior0/.5 plus mean. Same limited grids as E16, not exhaustive SOTA tuning.
secondary.selection: Pooled inner Brier; all3folds valid. Ties1e-12 then smaller outer numeric-array state then lexical candidate ID. Earlier valid RKNN checkpoints may survive later fit failure. Export explicit standalone states.
secondary.paired_selected_control: Apply U_min-selected budget/k/prior to G (G_atU); if U selects mean, both mean. Independently selected G/U are not capacity matched. Report mean-only counts. G_oneSE optional NOT in this stage, to avoid an additional selection heuristic.
secondary.direct_reduction: E17 remains the declared three-case development reconstruction. No new ProLSFEO outcomes or author-code reproduction claim is created by E18; extending the direct search requires a separately frozen execution/budget plan.

rater_disjoint_secondary.task: DICES only;5 additional outer cases, same item/context partitions and fitting cap
rater_disjoint_secondary.cohorts: Sorted released eligible rater IDs, numpy default_rng202611180700 permutation; floor70%training raters, remaining query raters. Verified120vs52, disjoint. No demographics in assignment.
rater_disjoint_secondary.targets: Outer fit and all inner-validation targets from training-rater cohort only. Outer query target from query-rater cohort only. No query-rater labels used in fitting/selection. At least10ratings per target item; unavailable target flagged, never replaced/resplit. Metadata check minimum42training/16query ratings.
rater_disjoint_secondary.interpretation: Joint new-conversation/new-annotator-population transport; targets and finite annotation noise change too, so not a pure leakage ablation or a substitute for original image-subject validation.

metrics_and_gate: Brier primary, original six secondary measures. Before any E18 scoring, freeze predictions for ALL15primary-task outer cases AND5rater-disjoint secondary cases, with failure records. Do not tune after seeing outer scores, replace seeds/corpora, substitute more favorable feature encoders or relabel Ren as confirmation. Keep original fixed primary unchanged.
resource_reporting: Report estimator numeric arrays, common TFIDF/SVD encoder state and serialized full deployable state separately; include vocabulary strings/IDF/SVD in deployment totals. Mean-only predictor can omit text encoder. No total-memory/speed claim from prototype arrays alone. Times on shared hardware descriptive.
privacy: Raw texts/votes/IDs, partitions, derived matrices and per-object predictions in authorized private Drive cache only. GitHub own code/protocol/source checksums/aggregate results only. No author contact or journal submission authorized.
